component.name: google-bigquery
component.title: Google BigQuery
component.description: Insert rows into Google BigQuery tables.
component.label: cloud,bigdata

connectionFactory.description: The org.apache.camel.component.google.bigquery.GoogleBigQueryConnectionFactory that provides the BigQuery client for the endpoints that do not set their own connectionFactory.

datasetId.description: The ID of a BigQuery dataset. Not used: an endpoint takes the dataset ID from its URI.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

projectId.description: The ID of a Google Cloud project. Not used: an endpoint takes the project ID from its URI.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

CamelGoogleBigQueryTableSuffix.description: The suffix of a template table: BigQuery inserts the rows into the table whose ID is the table ID followed by this suffix, and creates it with the schema of the table ID table if it does not exist.

CamelGoogleBigQueryTableId.description: The ID of the table to insert the rows into. It replaces the tableId of the endpoint. In a grouped exchange, an exchange without this header goes to the table of the exchange before it.

CamelGoogleBigQueryInsertId.description: The insert ID of the row of a Map body, which BigQuery uses to drop duplicate rows on a best-effort basis. It is not used for a List body, nor when the useAsInsertId option is set.

CamelGoogleBigQueryPartitionDecorator.description: The partition of a partitioned table to insert the rows into, such as 20260131 for a day. The producer appends it to the table ID as table$partition.

producerIn.description: The row to insert as a Map of column names to values, or a List of such Maps for one row each; the exchanges of a grouped aggregation are inserted together. Text such as JSON, bytes, a stream, a POJO, a List with an element that is not a Map, or no body fails: unmarshal it into a Map first. When one exchange of a grouped aggregation has such a body, the grouped exchange fails and none of its rows is inserted

projectId.label: common
projectId.description: The ID of the Google Cloud project of the dataset. The endpoint sets it as the project of the BigQuery client that it creates.

datasetId.label: common
datasetId.description: The ID of the BigQuery dataset that holds the table.

tableId.label: common
tableId.description: The ID of the table to insert the rows into. The CamelGoogleBigQueryTableId header replaces it. If neither is set, the exchange fails.

connectionFactory.description: The org.apache.camel.component.google.bigquery.GoogleBigQueryConnectionFactory that provides the BigQuery client. If not set, the connectionFactory of the component is used, and if that is not set either, the endpoint creates one from the serviceAccountKey and projectId options. With a factory that is set, the rows go to the dataset in the default project of its client.

useAsInsertId.description: The name of the field of each row whose value is the insert ID of the row, which BigQuery uses to drop duplicate rows on a best-effort basis. It applies to a Map body and to each Map of a List body. When set, the CamelGoogleBigQueryInsertId header is not used.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer,advanced
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

serviceAccountKey.label: security
serviceAccountKey.description: The location of the JSON key file of the service account to authenticate with Google Cloud, such as a classpath:, file: or https: resource, or base64: followed by the Base64 encoded content of the file. If not set, Application Default Credentials are used. It is not used when a connectionFactory is set.
